data.name: route-llm-code
data.description: CodeLLM's agent router: classifies each turn by complexity and routes it to Haiku, GLM, Sonnet or Opus. Built for coding agents, unlike route-llm. Rates shown are the ladder's most common destination; you are billed for the model each turn actually resolves to.

data.name: route-llm-code-low
data.description: The same classifier on the low-cost ladder (DeepSeek V4.1 Flash). The default lane for non-Pro callers. Rates shown are that ladder's destination; you are billed for the model each turn actually resolves to.

data.name: route-llm
data.description: RouteLLM is a model that routes the user's message to the appropriate text-generation model. Routing is prompt-cache aware, so follow-up turns keep hitting the provider's prompt cache. We will route to one of Sonnet 5, GPT-5.6 Terra, Grok 4.6, or Gemini 3.7 Flash models. The price shown is for the most expensive model (Sonnet 5) that we use.
